name: 4-MeO-PCP
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: An arylcyclohexamine dissociative anaesthetic related to PCP. First discovered in the 1960s by Parke-Davis, it was introduced to the RC market in 2008. There are reports of it being less potent than PCP. There is said to be an increase in usage due to the limited availability of other dissociatives.

pharmacology.text: 4-MeO-PCP has a lower affinity for the NMDA receptor than PCP, but a higher affinity than ketamine.

uses.text: 4-Methoxyphencyclidine (methoxydine, 4-MeO-PCP) is a dissociative anesthetic drug that has been sold online as a research chemical.

summaryZh: 4-甲氧基苯環己哌啶（別稱4-甲氧基苯環利定，簡稱：4-MeO-PCP）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C18H27NO，屬於苯環己哌啶（苯環利定）相關的芳基環己胺類解離型致幻劑。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include confusion, dissociation, loss of coordination, numbness, a faster heartbeat and raised blood pressure. Serious risks include agitation, mania, psychosis and dangerous accidents while impaired, and deaths have been reported. Repeated use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括意識混亂、解離、協調變差、麻木、心跳加快與血壓升高。嚴重風險包括躁動、躁症、精神病，以及在失能狀態下發生危險意外，也有死亡報告。反覆使用可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括意识混乱、解离、协调制差、麻木、心跳加快与血压升高。严重风险包括躁动、躁症、精神病，以及在失能状态下发生危险意外，也有死亡报告。反复使用可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: Chemists at Parke-Davis first made it in the 1960s while studying PCP, but it only reached the research chemical market in 2008, sometimes under the name methoxydine.
fact.zh: Parke-Davis的化學家在1960年代研究PCP時首次合成了它，但直到2008年才出現在研究化學品市場上，有時被稱為methoxydine。
fact.zhHans: Parke-Davis的化学家在1960年代研究PCP时首次合成了它，但直到2008年才出现在研究化学品市场上，有时被称为methoxydine。
